about: Strict labels of the chain the AST spike (FULL_AST, frozen checksum 219df349…) produces, from the calibration benchmark (benchmarks/flow-discovery.json) and the holdout (benchmarks/holdout/PREREGISTRATION.json). correct = answers the goal, edges proven, no evident false positive. wrong = a chain that does not answer the goal. incomplete = true but stops before the goal's action. no-chain = the spike itself returns nothing (it abstains on its own). Labels are used ONLY to score a rule, never as input to it.
